items.label: Product build exports retained create/apply/Enter/inverseJoin/dispose and revision-bound frames; QA fault/verifier stay private. Actual accepted retained session owns authored content/style/constraints and render facts.

Reuse existing Creator line-end shaping/layout concepts. For identical Thai/Latin source, Sarabun style and fixed constraints, compare old producer baseline glyph positions/linebreaks to new frame. No new engine, browser shaping or status-only bridge.

One authored paragraph supports committed typing/delete/selection/caret; authored Enter produces two paragraph sessions with preserved spans/defaults/empty sides and inverse join. State restrictions reported explicitly.
Core provisional composition updates produce visible Core frames; cancel restores base; final commit increments history once. Stale identity, rejected commands and disposal are atomic.

Focused native and actual release WASM tests plus Core npm run check pass; commit exact candidate and file list. Provide Editor consumption interface and limitations. No merge, persistence, maps, measurement certification or Editor edits.
